name: Centurion
bio: Archetype: AoE DPT, ST DPT, Self-Sustain. ⌽ Insight 1 grants DMG Bonus and Skill 1 deals additional damage based on current moxie. ⌽ Higher Moxie ➤ Higher damage; can forgo Ultimate for high ST damage. ⌽ High self-sustain with Insight 3 healing and [Weakness]; can forgo ST damage to spam Ultimate. ⌽ Consistent damage and utility at early, mid, and late game. ⌽ A relic of launch day meta.
